root_cause.text: The QMI element info array (`servreg_loc_pfr_req_ei`) declared the maximum length of the `reason` field as `SERVREG_NAME_LENGTH + 1` (65) instead of the actual buffer size (`SERVREG_PFR_LENGTH + 1 = 257`), causing QMI decoding to reject valid strings longer than 65 bytes and leading to decoding errors or potential buffer mismanagement.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `.elem_len` in `servreg_loc_pfr_req_ei` from `SERVREG_NAME_LENGTH + 1` to `SERVREG_PFR_LENGTH + 1` and adds `#define SERVREG_PFR_LENGTH 256`. The CVE description confirms the error message "String len 81 >= Max Len 65".
